items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: So then I worked with bands such as Tony Fambrough, Danny Williams, Johnny Long

ctx.x: So Roy said (unintelligible). I went up to the bandstand, took the base. First note, Art got up, he didn't have to look up, he knew who it was. So I stayed around there, and I worked with a wonderful musician, a bandleader, four pieces combo -- Les Wilcox. He could write and arrange individual parts. He could write music like you would write a letter, in long-hand. No score. This is the first time I had ever seen anything like that. He liked me. And they didn't have a bass player. So I'd go over there and sit,…
So then I worked with bands such as Tony Fambrough, Danny Williams, Johnny Long, black Johnny Long, not the white Johnny Long. He was a trumpet player and a cosmetologist.
